problems.problem: The contact-detail crop (462,1098)-(979,1348) now shows a credible soft contact shadow directly under the dark bottle base, so grounding is resolved (physical_integration raised 86→90). However, against the three references — Diptyque's layered florals and drapery, Jo Malone's peony foreground, Dior's tonal silk depth — this poster remains a single bottle on a flat sage field with only peripheral leaf shadows; the references build a signature midground/foreground layer that this frame lacks.

Typography scale was corrected (title now 56px, logo 30px, subtitle 22px, matching the applied patch and current text_bbox [84,120,599,157]), and the upper-left block now anchors the layout better (composition 78→84). Still, the right two-thirds below the headline is an empty sage field; there is no secondary visual device (soft foreground tone, dappled floor light shape) tying the text quadrant to the hero, so visual weight remains one-sided compared with the asymmetric-but-connected grids of the references.

The concept 'airy organic still-life' is expressed only by corner leaf shadows and the light pool; the headline block, bottle, and background still read as three separate layers rather than one light story. A stronger directional light-shape crossing the floor toward the bottle base would unify them.
